# Muhammad Kamran — Full Stack & AI Engineer (Japan)

> Muhammad Kamran is a Full Stack & AI Engineer based in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, Japan, with 5+ years of professional experience. He builds production web apps, SaaS platforms, ERPs and LLM-powered products with Laravel, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and FastAPI. He works in English and Japanese and is open to full-time roles in Japan and remote freelance work.

Website: https://kamranweb.vercel.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/mohakamran
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mokamran/
Email: mohammadkamran1515@gmail.com

## Key facts
- Role: Full Stack & AI Engineer (backend, front end, LLM applications)
- Location: Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, Japan (JST, UTC+9)
- Languages: English and Japanese
- Education: M.Sc. Applied Information Systems, University of Kitakyushu (2026), MEXT scholar; B.Sc. IT, University of Gujrat
- Experience: ~4 years as Full Stack Engineer at Reblate Solutions (15+ production apps, CRM that improved workflow efficiency by 70%); independent full stack & AI work since August 2024
- Research: traffic behaviour with Python and the CARLA driving simulator; papers at SICE 2026 and VTCA 2026
- Stack: Laravel/PHP 8, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Firebase, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, RAG, Shopify, WordPress

## AI case studies
- [Scholaria](https://github.com/mohakamran/scholaria): private, offline AI research assistant (Ollama, FastAPI, Streamlit, SQLite FTS5). Page-cited RAG answers, statistics computed in Python, 64 tests.
- [Personal Doctor AI](https://github.com/mohakamran/personal-doctor-ai): local-first health companion (React 19, FastAPI, OpenAI Responses API) with an emergency-symptom safety layer, 69 tests.
- [Japanese AI Tutor](https://github.com/mohakamran/japanese-ai-tutor): AI Japanese teacher with Pydantic-validated structured outputs and code-based quiz scoring, 208 tests.
- [JobAI Japan](https://github.com/mohakamran/jobai-japan): generates Japanese résumés (履歴書, 職務経歴書) with Gemini, plus job matching and an application tracker.
